title: CCOpt: an Open-Source Solver for Large-Scale Mathematical Programs with Complementarity Constraints
summary: This paper presents the Julia package CCOpt, built on top of the interior-point solver MadNLP. CCOpt implements a suite of algorithms for Mathematical Programs with Complementarity Constraints (MPCCs). The solver additionally comes with interfaces for use in Matlab, Python, and C++. MPCCs have recently gained renewed attention in engineering optimization, as complementarity provides a powerful modeling tool for nonsmooth functions and logical conditions.
